checks.observation: Finset families enforce distinct members; the sunflower predicate requires three distinct members and permits an empty core. Intersection includes self-pairs, and actual support is F.biUnion id. Support roots quantify over Type u; the literal I(27) equivalences use Type, while the separate counterexample reductions are universe-polymorphic, as the manuscript specifies.

checks.observation: The proof selects exactly 28 members, explicitly inherits all three family properties, applies the support53 root, and invokes injective finite relabeling. The reverse implication consumes obstruction nonexistence as an assumption; it does not derive an exclusion or an unrestricted extremal bound.
